The '''Ktilac Regions''' was an [[Allied Region]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Description==
The region contained a cluster of 192 [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] close to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The Ktilac Regions was a confederacy ruled by three [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Ktilac]], [[Murachaun]], and [[Tocoyan]]s. These species formed a common culture and religion where they saw themselves as complementary to each other and considered the rest of the galaxy unholy. Apostates of their religion were often exiled.<ref name="TEA" />

Each species ruled 63 systems. Only the [[Daedalon system/Legends|Daedalon]], [[Tun Wala system/Legends|Tun Wala]] and [[Vob system/Legends|Vob systems]] are open to outsiders, which was why the sector was known for its small amount of [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants.<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
The Ktilac Regions was in association with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] with the status of Allied Region that allowed it to conserve some independence. The Ktilac Regions also maintained this in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Diran Miciluz]] was a Human native of Ktilac, and his place of birth came as a surprise to anyone who met him.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
